instructions.title: How to capture (read me)
paragraphs: Add one row per capture. Give it a title, write or paste the note in the row's page, and put a link in URL if the capture is about a web page. Area or project is optional: the name of an area or project note in the vault, such as career, to link the capture to it.
A scheduled pull copies new rows into the vault's inbox and files each one. You don't need to set anything else.

Status: New (or blank) means waiting to be pulled. Ingested means it's in the vault. Failed means it needs a look; Reason says why. A row that couldn't be read is retried on the next pull, and after three failed pulls it stops with Reason saying so: set Status back to New to retry it. A row the vault couldn't file has an ask in the vault's inbox, named in Reason.
Supported content: paragraphs, headings, bulleted and numbered lists, to-dos and links. Other content, such as images, files and embeds, is left out, and the vault note says what was left out.
Once a row has been pulled, later edits to it are ignored. Rows are never deleted. This row is never pulled.
